name: T049: a narrowing that RESTATES the key it governs tightens that usage -- a value the root would have allowed and the house's narrower resource would not is rejected (spec.md Acceptance Scenario 2, SPEC.md §7's worked narrowing, first half). Value 'assets/main.css' is chosen over the worked example's own literal value for the same shape because isValidPath is permissive enough that it would ALSO satisfy accept:[url,path] -- narrowing to accept:[url] only is what actually distinguishes the two accept sets under the real matchers; see the milestone report.
